example: Greek artists transitioned from rigid geometric profiles to dynamic, sculptural depictions of human anatomy. (希臘藝術家從僵硬的幾何輪廓過渡到對人類解剖結構動態、雕塑般的描繪。)
Hydrothermal vents located on the volcanic seabed release mineral-rich fluids that feed chemosynthetic bacteria. (位於火山海床上的深海熱泉釋放出豐富的礦物質流體，滋養著化能合成細菌。)
The rugged seacoast of the Pacific Northwest is defined by dramatic cliffs and volatile weather systems. (美洲太平洋西北部崎嶇的海岸以壯麗的懸崖和多變的天氣系統為特徵。)
An ancient Polynesian seafarer memorized stellar charts to navigate across thousands of miles of open sea. (古代玻里尼西亞航海家記憶星圖，以在數千英里的開闊海域中航行。)
Seafloor spreading occurs at mid-ocean ridges where new oceanic crust is formed through volcanic activity. (海床擴張發生在中洋脊，此處透過火山活動形成新的海洋地殼。)
Ancient explorers constructed robust, seagoing vessels designed to withstand fierce oceanic storms. (古代探險家建造了堅固的遠洋船隻，旨在抵禦兇猛的海洋風暴。)
The veteran seaman expertly navigated the vessel through the turbulent and storm-tossed coastal waters. (這位老練的海員熟練地駕駛船隻穿過洶湧且風暴肆虐的海岸海域。)
The coastal seaport expanded into a massive mercantile metropolis, coordination oversea trade networks using advanced watercraft. (這座沿海海港城市發展成為一個巨大的商業大都市，利用先進的船隻協調海外貿易網絡。)
The chef used intense heat to sear the outside of the steak, locking in the natural juices. (主廚用高溫炙烤牛排的表面，以鎖住天然的肉汁。)
Neolithic gatherers handcrafted complex personal adornment jewelry pieces using fragmented marine seashell segments. (新石器時代的採集者利用碎片化的海洋海貝殼區段，手工製作出複雜的個人裝飾珠寶製品。)
Intertidal invertebrates living along the rocky seashore developed rigid shells to withstand intense tidal crashing waves. (生活在多石海岸沿線的潮間帶無脊椎動物長出了堅硬的外殼，以抵禦強烈的潮汐衝擊波。)
Desalination plants process seawater to provide drinkable water for coastal cities in arid zones. (海水淡化廠處理海水，為乾旱地區的沿海城市提供飲用水。)
The Western Interior Seaway once split North America, leaving rich marine deposits across modern plains. (西部內陸海路曾一度分裂北美洲，在現代平原上留下了豐富的海洋沉積物。)
Marine kelp is a massive seaweed that acts as an iodine accumulator, thriving inside nutrient-dense tidal currents. (海洋海帶是一種巨大的海草，扮演著碘累積者的角色，在營養密集的潮汐洋流內部繁盛生長。)
The shaman executed ritualistic trance ceremonies in absolute seclusion deep inside the sandstone cavern. (薩滿在砂岩溶洞深處絕對與世隔絕的狀態下，執行了宗教儀式的恍惚典禮。)
Specialized glands in the skin of amphibians secrete mucus to maintain essential moisture levels. (兩棲動物皮膚中的特化腺體會分泌黏液，以維持必要的濕度。)
The puritanical religious sect isolated itself from the metropolis to build a self-sufficient agrarian community. (這個清教徒宗教派別將自己與大都市隔離開來，以建立一個自給自足的農業社群。)

meaning: 部分的；部門的；組合式的
example: The civil engineer designed a sectional wooden roadbed blueprint to expedite railway building across uneven prairie wetlands. (土木工程師設計了一個組合式的（部分的）木製路基藍圖，以加快跨越不平坦大草原濕地的鐵路建設。)

meaning: 世俗的；非宗教的；（天文/地質）長期的
example: The gradual secular shift in Earth's orbital path dictates massive glaciation loops over deep geological timescales. (地球軌道路徑漸進的長期（地質/天文）轉變，在地質時間尺度上主導了大規模的冰河作用循環。)
The adoption of maize agriculture permitted migratory tribes to establish large, permanent, sedentary communities. (玉米農業的採用容許遷移的部落建立起大型、永久的定居社群。)
The river carries a large amount of sediment down to the delta. (河流將大量的沉積物帶入三角洲。)
High rates of soil erosion upstream amplify the rate of river sedimentation, choking downstream habitats. (上游高比率的土壤侵蝕放大了河流沉積作用的速度，阻塞了下游的棲地。)
An angiosperm seedling requires rich topsoil mineralization to synthesize the nutrients necessary for growth. (被子植物幼苗需要豐富的表土礦化作用，以合成生長所需的必要營養素。)
The pioneer prospector was an arduous independent wealth seeker who mapped out the southwestern desert for manganese. (這位拓荒探礦者是一位艱苦的獨立財富尋求者（探索者），他為了尋找錳礦而繪製了西南部沙漠的地圖。)
Rainwater can seep through layers of porous sandstone to replenish deep underground aquifers. (雨水會滲透多孔砂岩層，以補充深層地下含水層。)
Environmental engineers detected minor toxic chemical seepage from the underground storage tank into the local aquifer. (環境工程師偵測到地下儲水槽有輕微的有毒化學物質滲漏到當地的地下水層。)
The sensitive seismograph recorded minor tectonic vibrations hours before the major earthquake occurred. (在主震發生前數小時，敏感的地震儀就記錄到了輕微的構造震動。)
The doctor's selfless dedication to treating impoverished patients in remote villages earned universal praise. (這位醫生無私地致力於治療偏遠村莊的貧困患者，贏得了普遍的讚譽。)
In early mercantile urban marketplaces, a seller relied on a mesh sieve to standardize grain sizes for trade. (在早期的商業城市市場中，賣方依賴網眼篩子來使貿易的穀物大小標準化。)
Linguists study semantic shifts to understand how the meanings of individual words evolve over several centuries. (語言學家研究語義轉變，以了解單個字詞的意思在幾個世紀中是如何演變的。)
Semiarid ecosystems receive low overall precipitation and are vulnerable to desertification via overgrazing. (半乾旱生態系統的總降雨量較低，易因過度放牧而發生沙漠化。)
Tectonic plates drift dynamically upon the semimolten asthenosphere, driven directly by deep mantle convection streams. (在深層地函對流的直接驅動下，地殼板塊在半熔融的軟流圈之上進行動態漂移。)
Semiotics is the study of signs and symbols and their interpretation. (符號學是研究記號與符號及其解釋的學科。)
The expansion of mechanized assembly lines allowed factories to replace expert artisans with semiskilled laborers. (機械化裝配線的擴張使得工廠能夠用半熟練的勞工取代專家級的工匠。)
The Greek transition toward sculptural naturalism reflected a profound shift in the artistic sensibility of classical antiquity. (希臘向雕塑自然主義的過渡，反映了古典古代藝術審美能力（感性）的深刻轉變局勢。)
Greek sculptors carved marble character profiles sensitively, capturing detailed anatomical curves and bone lines perfectly. (希臘雕刻家審美向地（敏感地）鑿刻大理石人物輪廓，完美捕捉了精細的解剖曲線與骨骼線條。)
Nocturnal bats rely on auditory sensory feedback rather than vision to execute precise aerial navigation in total darkness. (夜行性group蝙蝠依賴聽覺感官回饋而非視覺，以在完全的黑暗中執行精確的空中導航。)
Critics argued that the film relied too heavily on cheap sentimentalism rather than a compelling, logical plot. (評論家認為這部電影過於依賴廉價的情感渲染，而不是引人入勝且具邏輯性的劇情。)

meaning: 被感傷化處理的；被情感化的
example: Early romanticist biographers often sentimentalized the harsh lives of preindustrial artisans. (早期浪漫主義傳記作者經常將工業化前工匠的艱苦生活感傷化處理。)
The outer green sepal array functions to securely encase and protect the vulnerable angiosperm bud before it sprouts into a bloom. (外層綠色萼片陣列起到牢固包圍並保護脆弱被子植物花蕾的作用，在牠抽芽開花之前提供保護。)
The judge decided to sequester the jury overnight to ensure they remained isolated from external media influence. (法官決定將陪審團隔離過夜，以確保他們不受外部媒體影響。)
The immense seriousness of groundwater salinization across semiarid farmlands prompted urgent federal irrigation bills. (半乾旱農田地下水鹽鹼化的巨大嚴重性，促成了緊急的聯邦灌溉法案。)
The historical surveyor mapped out the serpentine pathways of river delta distributaries cutting through the lowland plain. (歷史測量員繪製了穿過低地平原的河流三角洲分流的蜿蜒路徑。)
Scientists extracted the specific antibodies from the blood serum of patients who recovered from the virus. (科學家從病毒康復患者的血清中提取出了特異性抗體。)
Although the laboratory computers are outdated, they remain entirely serviceable for basic database entry. (雖然實驗室的電腦已經過時，但對於基本的資料庫輸入，它們仍然完全可用。)
The workplace policy was revised to eliminate all forms of sexism. (修改了職場政策以消除一切形式的性別歧視。)
Synchronized spawning allows marine invertebrates to reproduce sexually by flooding tidal currents with gamete cells. (同步產卵容許海洋無脊椎動物透過在潮汐洋流中充斥配子細胞，來進行有性生殖（生殖向）。)
In many Paleolithic tribes, the shaman acted as a mediator between human groups and supernatural forces. (在許多舊石器時代的部落中，薩滿扮演著人類群體與超自然力量之間的調解者。)
Before being placed onto the pottery wheel, the raw clay was merely a shapeless lump of grey earth. (在被放到陶輪上之前，原始的黏土僅僅是一團無定形的灰色泥塊。)
Greek sculptors utilized advanced iron chisels to incise sharper anatomical muscles into naturalistic marble statuary. (希臘雕刻家利用先進的鐵鑿，在寫實的（自然主義）大理石雕像上雕刻出更清晰（更銳利）的解剖肌肉。)
The warrior placed his sharp sword back into its protective leather sheath. (戰士將鋒利的劍放回保護性的皮革劍鞘中。)
Due to a sudden deficit in federal funding, the government decided to shelve the proposed infrastructure project. (由於聯邦資金突然出現赤字，政府決定擱置擬議中的基礎設施計畫。)
Anatomical skeletal tracking confirmed that early bipedal hominids possessed elongated shin structures tailored for walking. (解剖骨骼追蹤證實，早期的雙足原始人類擁有專為步行而量身定制的延伸脛骨構造。)
The abundance of tall cedar and oak timberline forests supported a booming maritime shipbuilding sector along the coast. (豐富的高大雪松與橡樹林木線森林，支持了沿海地區繁榮的海洋造船業。)
Responsible team members do not shirk their historical administrative duties when deadlines approach. (當截止日期接近時，負責的團隊成員不會逃避他們歷史性的行政職責。)
Before mechanized piecework assembly lines expanded, an individual artisan shoemaker handcrafted single leather shields. (在機械化計件工作裝配線擴張之前，單個工匠鞋匠手工製作單一的皮革防護製品。)
The industrialization of shoemaking transitioned the craft from localized artisan workshops to mechanized piecework factories. (製鞋業的工業化將這項工藝，從地方工匠工作坊轉移到了機械化的計件工作工廠。)
The businessman stopped at the station for a quick shoeshine before entering the executive boardroom. (商人在進高階主管董事會會議室之前，在車站停下來快速擦鞋。)
Relentless tidal waves erode the erratic granite boulders scattered across the rugged seashore shoreline. (無休止的潮汐波浪侵蝕著散佈在崎嶇海濱海岸線上的漂礫花崗岩巨石。)
The shortness of the academic semester meant that certain advanced historical topics could only be surveyed briefly. (學術學期的短暫意味著某些進階的歷史課題只能被簡要地概述。)

meaning: 擅長表演的人；演藝界企業家
example: The early vaudeville showman traveled across preindustrial towns, offering cheap visual entertainment to laborers. (早期的綜藝雜耍演藝企業家旅行穿越工業化前的城鎮，向勞工提供廉價的視覺娛樂。)
Glacial shrinkage records offer clear proxy physical proof tracking the rise of modern global temperatures. (冰河收縮（減少）的記錄，提供了追蹤現代全球氣溫上升的明確替代物理證據。)
Without adequate rainfall and irrigation, the corn crops began to shrivel and die under the intense heat. (在沒有充足降雨和灌溉的情況下，玉米作物開始在烈日高溫下枯萎死亡。)
A thick shroud of dense industrial smog covered the valley city, reducing visibility to less than a mile. (一層厚重濃密的工業煙霧掩蓋了山谷城市，將能見度降低到不到一英里。)
The arid ecological zone is dominated by low, shrubby vegetation adapted to minimal annual rainfall. (這個乾旱的生態區主要由適應了極少每年度降雨量的矮小灌木狀植被所主導。)
The article features a sidebar with additional facts about the scientist. (文章包含一個側邊欄，其中包含有關這位科學家的其他背景資料。)
Archaeologists use a mesh sieve to separate small organic residues and beads from excavated loose soil. (考古學家使用網眼篩子，將微小的有機殘留物和珠子從挖掘出的鬆散土壤中篩分出來。)
The alpha wolf acts as a primary vocal signaler, using howling to coordinate group defense across the valley. (領頭狼充當核心的發聲信號生物，利用嚎叫來協調整個山谷內的群體防禦。)
Silicate minerals make up the vast majority of Earth's stony crust and internal upper mantle. (矽酸鹽礦物構成了地球絕大多數的岩石地殼和內部上地函。)
Obsidian is an exceptionally dense, glassy, siliceous igneous rock configuration formed when viscous lava cools instantaneously. (黑曜石是一種異常緻密、玻璃質、富含矽的（矽質的）火成岩構造，是當黏稠的岩漿瞬間冷卻時形成的。)
As a river slows down near its delta, it deposits fine silt that enriches agricultural soil. (當河水在其三角洲附近減速時，會沉積出肥沃農業土壤的細粉砂。)
An expert silversmith could hammer crude bullion into exceptionally delicate ornamental chalices. (一位專家銀匠能將粗糙的條銀錘打成異常精緻的裝飾性聖杯。)
The poet used a beautiful simile to compare her eyes to brilliant stars. (詩人使用了一個美麗的明喻，將她的眼睛比作璀璨的星星。)
The linguistic transition from complex cuneiform symbols to alphabetic scripts represents an evolutionary simplification. (從複雜的楔形文字符號向字母文字的語言轉變，代表了一種演化上的簡化。)

meaning: 滲穴；塌陷洞（喀斯特地形特徵）
example: A sudden sinkhole opened up in the karst landscape as acidic groundwater completely collapsed the limestone cavern roof. (由於酸性地下水使石灰岩溶洞屋頂完全塌陷，喀斯特地形中突然出現了一個塌陷滲穴。)
The river delta pathways display a sinuous pattern as silt deposition slows the water velocity near the basin. (隨著粉砂沉積在盆地附近降低水流速度，河流三角洲路徑展現出蜿蜒的型態。)
Ancestral pueblo builders chose to situate their multi-story stone villages deep inside defensive sandstone alcoves. (祖傳普埃布洛建造者選擇將他們的多層石造村落，使坐落於具防禦性的砂岩凹處深處。)
Paleontologists cleared the shale matrix to analyze the structural skeletal adaptations that enabled the transitional reptile to swim. (古生物學家清除了頁岩基質，以分析使這隻過渡期爬蟲類能夠游泳的結構骨骼適應性。)
The hypothesis regarding a catastrophic asteroid mass extinction initially faced intense scientific skepticism inside geology. (關於毀滅性小行星大規模滅絕的假設，最初在地質學內部面臨了強烈的科學懷疑態度。)
Architects designed the museum with a massive glass skylight to illuminate the central exhibition hall with natural daylight. (建築師在設計博物館時採用了巨大的玻璃天窗，以便用自然日光照亮中央展覽廳。)
Artisans utilized a flat limestone slab as a canvas for etching intricate geometric motifs and inscriptions. (工匠利用一塊平坦的石灰岩厚板，作為刻劃複雜幾何圖案與銘文的畫布。)
Economic growth began to slacken during the final quarter of the fiscal year due to rising interest rates. (由於利率上升，經濟增長在財政年度的最後一季開始放緩。)
The construction firm was penalized for its slapdash repair work on the historic public bridge. (該建築公司因其對這座歷史悠久的公共橋樑進行草率馬虎的修復工作而受到處罰。)
Early twentieth-century cinema relied heavily on slapstick comedy to entertain audiences without dialogue. (二十世紀初期的電影極大地依賴鬧劇喜劇，在沒有對白的情況下娛樂觀眾。)
The artist was criticized for his slavish imitation of classical styles rather than developing a unique voice. (這位藝術家因盲目模仿古典風格而未能發展出獨特的個人聲音而受到批評。)
The sleek fluid anatomy of marine seals is an evolutionary breakdown adaptation designed to minimize seawater fluid resistance. (海洋海豹光滑的流線型解剖結構，是一種旨在將海水流體阻力降到最低的演化適應。)
Avian physiologists tracked how winter circadian rhythms alter hormone secretions, inducing migratory sleepiness in birds. (鳥類生理學家追蹤了冬季晝夜節律如何改變荷爾蒙分泌，從而在鳥類中引發遷徙性嗜睡。)
Biologists analyzed the thick protective slime produced by the aquatic organisms to deter predators. (生物學家分析了水生生物所產生的黏稠保護性黏液，用以嚇阻捕食者。)
The cave walls were coated in a slimy layer of bacterial biofilm that flourished in the absolute darkness. (洞穴牆壁上覆蓋著一層黏滑的細菌生物膜，在完全黑暗的環境中蓬勃生長。)
The soldiers had to slog through deep, muddy trenches for hours before reaching the military outpost. (士兵們不得不在深邃、泥濘的戰壕中艱難行進數小時，才到達軍事哨所。)
Turbulent ocean currents caused the watercraft's storage fluid to slop over, damaging raw textile cargoes. (湍急的洋流導致船隻儲存的液體晃蕩溢出，損壞了紡織原料貨物。)
The giant ground sloth was a prehistoric herbivore that vanished at the end of the last Ice Age. (巨型地懶是一種在最後一次冰河期結束時消失的史前食草動物。)
The corporate manager criticized the slothful work habits of the underperforming administrative department. (公司經理批評了表現不佳的行政部門偷懶怠惰的工作習慣。)
Certain reptiles slough their skin periodically to allow for rapid growth. (某些爬行動物會定期脫落皮膚以促進快速生長。)
Tectonic plates move so slowly that their displacement is measured in centimeters per year. (地殼板塊移動得非常緩慢，其位移是以每年幾公分來計算的。)
The deliberate slowness of the tectonic plate movement makes continental drift imperceptible to human senses. (構造板塊運動蓄意的緩慢，使得大陸漂移無法被人類感官所察覺。)
The global retail economy responded sluggishly to the central bank's dramatic reduction in interest rates. (全球零售經濟對中央銀行大幅調降利率的舉措反應緩慢。)
Subterranean burrowing mammals enter a deep metabolic slumber to conserve energy resources during polar tundra winters. (地下挖洞的哺乳動物進入深層的新陳代謝休眠（睡眠），以在極地凍原寒冬期間節省能量資源。)
As spring temperatures rise, glacial surfaces develop a layer of slush that accelerates solar heat absorption. (隨著春季氣溫升高，冰河表面會形成一層融雪，這加速了對太陽熱量的吸收。)
Prehistoric cave painters would smear natural iron-oxide pigments mixed with animal fats onto bare limestone slabs. (史前洞穴畫家會將混合了動物脂肪的天然氧化鐵顏料，塗抹到裸露的石灰岩厚板上。)
Ancient metalworkers utilized specialized kilns to smelt copper and iron ores into workable industrial bullion slabs. (古代金屬工匠利用特化的窯，來熔煉銅與鐵礦石成可加工的工業條塊厚板。)
The industrial revolution led to advancements in iron smelting techniques. (工業革命帶來了鐵礦冶煉技術的進步。)
He couldn't hide his smirk when he won the poker game. (當他贏了撲克牌局時，他掩飾不住得意的笑。)
The engineering firm tested the surface smoothness of the aerodynamic composite wing structures. (工程公司測試了氣動複合材料機翼結構的表面光滑度。)
The politician's snide remarks about his opponent's background were widely criticized by the mainstream media. (這位政治人物對其對手背景的尖酸諷刺，受到了主流媒體的廣泛批評。)
The historical documentarian cross-referenced each recorded snippet of oral storytelling lore to reconstruct the ancestral tribal lifeway. (歷史紀錄片工作者交叉比對了口頭說故事傳說的每個錄製片段，以重塑祖傳部落的生活方式。)
The harsh polar blizzard generated a massive snowdrift that completely blocked the multi-story entrances of the igloo complex. (嚴酷的極地暴風雪產生了一個巨大的雪堆，完全堵塞了雪屋建築群的多層入口。)
Heavy annual snowfall in the mountains feeds the glaciers that supply freshwater during summer melts. (山區每年大量的降雪補給了冰河，進而在夏季融化時提供淡水。)
The hexagonal structural geometry of a snowflake is determined by the molecular bonds of water vapor as it freezes. (雪花的六角形結構幾何形狀是由水蒸氣結冰時的分子鍵結所決定的。)
A severe winter snowstorm can trap migratory bird groups, multiplying nestling vulnerability to coastal predators. (一場嚴酷的冬季暴風雪會困住遷徙的鳥群，乘倍乘增加雛鳥對沿海捕食者的脆弱性。)
Researchers analyzed the correlation between high sociability in primates and their overall survival rates. (研究人員分析了靈長類動物的高度善於社交與其整體生存率之間的相關性。)
Psychologists analyze how imitative interactions inside preschool academies accelerate cognitive socialization tracking metrics. (心理學家分析幼兒園機構內部的模仿互動，如何加速認知的社會化追蹤指標。)
Early chiefdom groups were socially stratified, dividing wealth between aristocratic rulers and craftspeople. (早期酋邦群體在社會上是分層的（階級化的），在貴族統治者與手工藝人之間分配財富。)
Sociobiology posits that complex social actions, such as eusocial labor division in ants, are genetically encoded. (社會生物學假定，複雜的社會行為（如螞蟻中的真社會性勞動分工）是由基因編碼的。)
A sociologist studies how urban development influences social interactions and neighborhood cohesion. (社會學家研究城市發展如何影響社會互動與社區凝聚力。)
The metallurgical team tested the structural softness of the annealed copper alloy under extreme temperature loads. (冶金團隊測試了退火銅合金在極端溫度負載下的結構柔軟度。)
Coniferous trees like spruce and pine provide softwood, which is extensively logged for mechanical paper production. (像雲杉和松樹這樣的針葉樹提供了軟木，這類木材被廣泛砍伐以用於機械造紙工業。)
The adoption of soilless hydroponic farming setups maximizes plant resource conductance while eliminating agricultural runoff problems. (無土水耕耕作裝置的採用，在最大化植物資源導度的同時，清除了農業逕流問題。)
Modern metallurgy technicians utilize lead-free solder alloys to fuse crystalline metal components firmly into electronic circuit boards. (現代冶金技術人員利用無鉛銲料合金，將結晶金屬部件牢固地焊接融合到電子電路板中。)
As extruded basaltic lava flows cool under seawater, they quickly solidify into characteristic pillow formations. (隨著噴出的玄武岩岩漿流在海水中冷卻，牠們會迅速凝固成特徵性的枕狀構造。)
The chief financial officer assured investors that the corporation remained entirely solvent despite market instability. (財務長向投資人保證，儘管市場不穩定，公司依然完全具備償付能力。)
The atmosphere in the boardroom became somber as the executive announced the sudden company layoffs. (當主管宣布公司突然裁員時，董事會會議室的氣氛變得十分沉重。)
The early Broadway theatre industry relied on the creative versatility of the individual songwriter to shape musical plots. (早期的百老匯劇院產業依賴個別詞曲作家的創意多功能性，來塑造音樂劇的情節。)
The jet aircraft created a powerful sonic boom as it accelerated past the speed of sound. (這架噴射機在加速超越音速時，產生了強大的音爆。)

meaning: 使複雜；使精緻；老練的人
example: Technological advancements continue to sophisticate the instruments used by meteorologists to predict storms. (技術的進步持續使氣象學家預測暴風雨所使用的儀器變得更加精密。)
The high technical sophistication of Mayan mathematical zero utilization surpassed many contemporary preindustrial tools. (馬雅人利用數學零的高度技術複雜性，超越了許多同時代的工業化前工具。)
The famous soprano will perform the leading role in the opera tonight. (著名的女高音今晚將在歌劇中擔任主角。)

meaning: 健全地、牢固地、香甜地（睡覺）
example: The scientific hypothesis was soundly supported by decades of peer-reviewed empirical research. (該科學假說得到了數十年同儕審查經驗研究的健全支持。)
Monsoon patterns in the southeast portion of Asia bring torrential rainfall during the summer months. (亞洲東南地區的季風型態在夏季月份帶來了暴雨。)
The southeastern coast of North America is vulnerable to severe hurricanes originating in the Atlantic. (北美洲東南海岸易受到源自大西洋的嚴重颶風侵襲。)
During autumn, migratory herds begin their southward journey to escape the severe Arctic winters. (秋季期間，遷徙的獸群開始牠們的向南旅程，以躲避嚴酷的北極寒冬。)
Winds blowing from the southwest brought warm, moisture-laden air to the coastal mountain ranges. (從西南方吹來的風將溫暖且富含水分的空氣帶到了沿海山脈。)
The southwestern United States is characterized by arid deserts and distinctive canyon landscapes. (美國西南部以乾旱的沙漠和獨特的峽谷景觀為其特徵。)
Modern parenting experts generally advise against using physical discipline, such as choosing to spank a child. (現代育兒專家通常建議不要使用體罰，例如選擇打小孩屁股。)

meaning: 圓木（帆檣等）；（拳擊）輕拳練習；爭論
example: The sailboat's wooden spar snapped during the severe storm, forcing the crew to head back to the harbor. (這艘帆船的木製桅杆在暴風雨中折斷，迫使船員返回港口。)
Vegetation inside the hyper-arid semiarid shrublands remains exceptionally sparse due to low annual rainwater deposits. (由於年雨量沉積低，半乾旱灌木地內部的植被保持異常稀疏。)
Marine fish gather inside shallow estuarine seaways to spawn, flooding tidal wetlands with biological gametes. (海洋魚類聚集在淺淺的河口海上航道內產卵，使潮汐濕地充斥著生物配子。)
Educator reformers in the northeast helped spearhead the movement for standardized, state-funded public schools. (東北部的教育家改革派幫助帶頭發起了旨在建立標準化、州政府資助公共學校的運動。)
The unique structural vitrification of high-temperature stoneware glaze was the core artistic speciality of the guild master. (高溫炻器釉料獨特的結構玻璃化，是該公會大師的核心藝術專業（特長）。)
Labor specialization during the Industrial Revolution significantly boosted manufacturing productivity. (工業革命期間的勞動分工大幅提升了製造業的生產力。)
The mineral samples exhibit a unique gold speckle pattern under the high-resolution microscope. (這些礦物樣本在高解析度顯微鏡下，展現出獨特的黃金斑點圖案。)
The dinosaur population diversified spectacularly during the Mesozoic era, occupying every terrestrial ecological niche. (恐龍族群在中生代期間壯觀地多樣化，佔據了每一個陸地生態棲位。)
Without direct fossilization evidence, current theories regarding the color of dinosaur scales remain purely speculative. (在缺乏直接化石證據的情況下，目前關於恐龍鱗片顏色的理論仍純屬推測。)
An entrepreneurial land speculator bought vast midwest prairie hectares, anticipating the expansion of intercity railway networks. (一位具創業精神的土地投機者購買了廣闊的中西部大草原公頃，預期著城市間鐵路網路的擴張。)
The magician's incredible performance managed to spellbind the entire audience. (魔術師不可思議的表演成功迷住了全場觀眾。)
Subsurface volcanic vents along the oceanic rift zone can spew massive volumes of molten lava and sulfur dioxide. (沿著海洋裂谷帶的地表下火山噴發口，會噴出大量的熔融岩漿與二氧化碳硫。)
A primitive stony chondrite is characterized by internal spherical mineral inclusions formed within the solar nebula. (原始石質球粒隕石的特徵是內部含有在太陽星雲中形成的球形礦物內含物。)
The Earth is not a perfect sphere but rather an oblate spheroid. (地球不是一個完美的球體，而是一個扁球體。)

meaning: 像蜘蛛網的、細長如蜘蛛足的
example: The ancient manuscript was covered in faint, spidery handwriting that required a magnifying lens to decipher. (這份古老的手稿上佈滿了微弱、細長如蜘蛛足般的字跡，需要放大鏡才能辨認。)
The evolution of a rigid spinal column granted early vertebrates the structural agility needed for predatory propulsion. (僵硬脊椎骨的演化，賦予了早期無脊椎動物捕食性推進所需的結構敏捷性。)

meaning: 小型大鍵琴；小型立式鋼琴
example: The ancient spinet possessed a minuscule dynamic scale, suited solely for private parlor musical recitals inside tenements. (古代的小型大鍵琴具備微小的動態範圍，僅適合在住宅內部的私人沙龍音樂獨奏會。)
The traditional spinning wheel was replaced by automated textile machines. (傳統的紡紗輪被自動化紡織機所取代。)
A tiny wooden splinter embedded in the finger can cause significant discomfort and local inflammation. (一根卡在手指裡的小木屑會引起明顯的不適與局部發炎。)
Bacterial micro-infestations trigger rapid organic foodstuff spoilage unless commodities are sealed inside cold refrigeration lofts. (微生物細菌感染會引發有機食品糧食快速的腐敗（變質），除非商品被密封在冰冷的冷藏閣樓內部。)
The theater director encouraged creative spontaneity during rehearsals to foster organic character growth. (戲劇導演在排練期間鼓勵創造性的自發性，以促進角色自然的成長。)
The remote region experienced sporadic outbreaks of the disease, prompting a localized public health response. (該偏遠地區出現了零星的疾病爆發，引發了地方性的公共衛生應對措施。)
Fungal spores are incredibly resilient, capable of remaining dormant until optimal environmental moisture returns. (真菌孢子的生命力極其頑強，能夠保持休眠，直到最佳的環境水分恢復。)

meaning: 噴出；噴嘴；（鯨魚的）噴水柱
example: A whale's vaporous spout is formed when warm, pressurized respiration air condenses upon entering cold polar atmosphere. (當溫暖、受壓的呼吸空氣在進入寒冷的極地大氣時發生凝結，就會形成鯨魚的霧狀噴水柱。)
The small-scale subsistence horticulture setups of early Neolithic tribes served as a springboard for extensive plow agriculture. (早期新石器時代部落小規模的維持生存園藝配置，充當了廣泛犁作農業的跳板（出發點）。)
The botanical gardens exhibit an extraordinary profusion of vibrant blossoms during the height of springtime. (在春季最盛之時，植物園展示了極其豐富且充滿活力的盛開花朵。)
Angiosperm seed pods buried beneath fertile compost will rapidly sprout following the initial onset of warm spring rainfall. (埋在肥沃堆肥下方的被子植物種莢，在溫暖春雨最初開始之後會迅速發芽（抽芽）。)
The black spruce is a highly resilient coniferous tree that marks the northern timberline border of the Arctic tundra. (黑雲杉是一種高度具恢復力的針葉樹，標記了北極凍原北部的林木線邊界。)
The dress was made from finely spun silk threads imported from Asia. (這件連身裙是由從亞洲進口的精紡絲線製成的。)
The proud artist decided to spurn the lucrative commercial offer. (這位驕傲的藝術家決定拒絕這筆有利可圖的商業邀約。)
The children always squabble over who gets to play the game first. (孩子們總是為了誰先玩遊戲而爭吵。)
Agrarian societies in semiarid lands cannot afford to squander precious rainwater runoff resources via inefficient overirrigation. (半乾旱土地上的農業社會，承受不起透過無效率的過度灌溉來浪費（揮霍）珍貴的雨水逕流資源。)
The responsibility for preventing groundwater over-extraction rests squarely on the centralized state regulatory administration. (防止地下水過度抽取的責任，正面地落在中央集權的國家監管行政當局身上。)
The laboratory floorboards would squeak slightly whenever anyone walked past the sensitive measurement equipment. (每當有人走過敏感的測量設備時，實驗室的地板就會發出輕微的吱吱聲。)
Giant squid are deep-sea creatures that are rarely seen by humans. (大王烏賊是很少被人類看見的深海生物。)
Before railroads linked regions, the stagecoach served as the primary means of long-distance overland passenger travel. (在鐵路連接各區域之前，驛馬車是長途陸路旅客旅行的主要工具。)
The factory implemented staggered work shifts to comply with the government's social distancing guidelines. (工廠實施了交錯的輪班制，以符合政府的社交距離指引。)
A sudden loud noise triggered a massive elephant stampede across the African savannah conservation area. (突如其來的巨大噪音引發了非洲大草原保護區內大象的大規模驚逃。)
The young actress achieved international stardom overnight following her critically acclaimed performance in the indie film. (這位年輕女演員在獨立電影中獲得好評的演出後，一夜之間獲得了國際明星地位。)

meaning: 星形的、像星星一樣閃爍的
example: The remote sensing technology captured starlike reflections from the mineral deposits buried in the desert. (遙測技術捕捉到了埋藏在沙漠中的礦床所反射出如星星般閃爍的光芒。)
The researchers made a startling discovery about deep-sea life. (研究人員對深海生物有了一個令人震驚的發現。)
Ancient Greek statuary transitioned toward intense naturalism, capturing fluid anatomical curves and motion profiles. (古希臘雕像轉向強烈的自然主義，捕捉流暢的解剖曲線與運動輪廓。)
The archeological team unearthed a small bronze statuette depicting an ancient fertility goddess. (考古團隊挖掘出了一尊描繪古代豐饒女神的小型青銅雕像。)

meaning: 堅定的；忠實的；止住（出血）
example: The senator remained a staunch defender of civil rights throughout his lengthy career in public service. (在漫長的公共服務生涯中，這位參議員一直是公民權利的堅定捍衛者。)

meaning: 桶板；狹板；擊退（與 off 連用）
example: To stave off seasonal starvation, sedentary agrarian groups stored substantial surpluses of grain inside airtight underground silos. (為了擊退季節性的飢餓，定居的農業群體在密閉的地下糧倉內儲存了大量的剩餘糧食。)
The steamboat drastically reduced travel times along the Mississippi River, accelerating domestic commerce. (汽船大幅縮短了密西西比河沿岸的航行時間，加速了國內商業發展。)
The iron-hulled steamship replaced transatlantic wooden sailing vessels, stabilizing international trade schedules. (鐵殼蒸汽船取代了橫跨大西洋的木製帆船，穩固了國際貿易的時間表。)
The ancient granite stele was inscribed with royal decrees detailing the economic reforms of the pharaoh. (這塊古代花崗岩石碑上刻有皇家法令，詳細記載了法老的經濟改革。)
The failure of the waste processing plant resulted in a pervasive stench that spread across the entire city. (廢棄物處理廠的故障導致了一股無孔不入的惡臭，蔓延到整個城市。)
Prehistoric cave artists used a primitive stencil technique, blowing pigment over their hands pressed against walls. (史前洞穴藝術家使用原始的模板技術，將顏料吹在緊貼牆壁的手上。)
The vast, semiarid Eurasian steppe features sparse tree growth and is highly suited for pastoral nomadism. (廣闊、半乾旱的歐亞大草原以稀疏的樹木生長為特徵，非常適合畜牧游牧生活。)
The automated industrial robotics system utilizes high-precision stepper motors to control limb movements. (自動化工業機器人系統利用高精密的步進馬達，來控制肢體移動。)
Early vaudeville entertainment formats relied heavily on stereotypical character profiles that featured extreme satiric wit. (早期的綜藝雜耍娛樂形式高度依賴刻板印象的角色特徵，這些特徵以極端的諷刺機智為特色。)
Persistent overirrigation deposits toxic alkali mineral crusts, transforming fertile topsoil layers into sterile lands. (持續的過度灌溉沉積了有毒的鹼性礦物地殼，將肥沃的表土層轉化為貧瘠的（不育的）土地。)
The chef placed the fresh vegetables and chunks of beef into the large stewpot to simmer for hours. (主廚將新鮮蔬菜和牛肉塊放進大燉鍋中慢火慢燉數小時。)
Arthropods utilize structural proteins to stiffen their newly formed chitin exoskeletons immediately after they molt. (節肢動物在脫皮後會立即利用結構蛋白質來使其新形成的幾丁質外骨骼變硬。)
High corporate tax rates can sometimes stifle innovation by reducing the capital available for experimental R&D. (高額的公司稅率有時會藉由減少可用於實驗性研發的資金，來壓制創新。)
Public health campaigns aim to eliminate the social stigma historically associated with mental health diagnoses. (公共衛生運動旨在消除歷史上與心理健康診斷相關的社會汙名。)
The absolute stillness of the early morning lake created a perfect mirror reflection of the sky. (清晨湖面絕對的寧靜，創造出了天空完美的鏡面反射。)
Coastal communities often construct their homes on tall concrete stilts to mitigate damage from tidal surges. (沿海社區經常將房屋建造在高大的混凝土高腳柱上，以減輕潮汐暴漲帶來的損害。)
The honeybee leaves its venomous stinger embedded in the skin of the perceived threat after attacking. (工蜂在攻擊後，會將其帶毒的螫針留置在被視為威脅的皮膚內。)
After a brief stint as a frontier surveyor, the enterprising speculator bought hectares of midwest prairie. (在擔任邊疆測量員的一段短暫工作期間後，這位具開創精神的投機者購買了數公頃的中西部大草原。)
The organization's organizational bylaws explicitly stipulate that all guild members must register their handcraft specialty marks. (該組織的組織章程明確規定，所有公會成員都必須登記他們的手工藝專業標記。)
The skeletal tracking showed that Neanderthals possessed a stocky bipedal anatomy tailored for cold weather constraints. (骨骼追蹤顯示，尼安德塔人具備專為寒冷天氣限制而量身定制的矮壯雙足解剖結構。)

meaning: 炻器；非 porous 的厚陶器
example: Stoneware is a durable type of pottery fired at high temperatures, making it non-porous and vitreous. (炻器是一種在高溫下燒製的耐用陶器，這使其不具多孔性且呈玻璃質。)
A chondrite is a stony meteorite that offers a pristine chemical record of early planetary condensation. (球粒隕石是一種石質（多石的）隕石，為早期行星的凝聚提供了原始的化學記錄。)
Libraries are not merely buildings containing books, but irreplaceable storehouses of human knowledge and history. (圖書館不僅僅是藏書的建築，更是人類知識與歷史不可替代的寶庫。)
Oral storytelling served as the primary mechanism for transmitting historical lore and cultural values in ancient non-literate societies. (口頭說故事在古代無文字社會中，是傳遞歷史傳說和文化價值的核心機制。)
The military historian analyzed the brilliant stratagem employed by the general to outmaneuver the opposing forces. (軍事歷史學家分析了將軍用以勝過敵對部隊的精妙計謀。)
Stratigraphy allows geologists to determine the relative age of rock layers. (地層學使地質學家能夠確定岩層的相對年齡。)
The rapid mountain stream deposits coarse gravel and boulders along its rugged erosion-carved streambed profile. (急促的山區溪流沿著其崎嶇、受侵蝕雕琢的河床輪廓，沉積下粗糙的礫石與巨石。)
The research expedition required a strenuous trek through dense tropical rainforests. (這次研究考察需要徒步穿越濃密熱帶雨林的艱苦跋涉。)
Biologists discovered that a specialized subsurface soil bacterium naturally synthesizes streptomycin to combat competing microbial groups. (生物學家發現，一種特化的地表下土壤細菌能天然合成鏈黴素，以對抗競爭的微生物群。)
The distribution of vegetation is strongly influenced by slight variations in altitude and aspect. (植被的分布受到高度和坡向微小變異的強烈影響。)
Granite is structurally durable due to large, interlocking crystalline silicate mineral arrays cooled deep within the planet's crust. (花崗岩在結構上地非常耐用，這是因為行星地殼深處內部冷卻的巨大、相互鎖緊的結晶矽酸鹽礦物陣列所致。)

meaning: 支柱；撐桿；耀武揚威地走
example: Archaeologists found fossilized cedar struts used to support the unstable roofs of underground ancestral pueblo dwellings. (考古學家發現了被用來支撐地底祖傳普埃布洛住宅不穩定屋頂的雪松木支柱化石。)

meaning: （作物收割後留下的）殘茬；落頭打穀殘莖
example: The mechanical reaper swept through midwest farmlands, farmlands, leaving a uniform field layer of dense wheat stubble. (機械收割機橫掃中西部農田，留下一層均勻的密集小麥殘茬（殘頁）。)
The executive's stubbornness regarding institutional change ultimately led to his replacement by the board. (這位高階主管對於機構變革的頑固態度，最終導致他被董事會撤換。)
Archaeologists found ancient metal studs used to reinforce the leather shields of the soldiers. (考古學家發現了古代的金屬飾鈕，用來補強士兵的皮革盾牌。)
The architectural engineers verified the sturdiness of the foundation before authorizing the high-rise project. (建築工程師在批准高層建築專案之前，驗證了地基的堅固性。)

meaning: 使風格化；使符合某種傳統風格
example: Ancient Egyptian reliefs would stylize the human form, conforming strictly to rigid artistic formulas of frontality. (古埃及浮雕會將人類形態風格化，嚴格符合僵硬的正面性藝術公式。)
The ancient cave paintings depicted animals in a highly stylized manner. (古代洞穴壁畫以高度風格化的方式描繪了動物。)
Dreams are often considered a window into the human subconscious. (夢境通常被認為是通往人類潛意識的窗口。)
Sociologists extensively study the unique norms and values that define urban youth subculture. (社會學家廣泛研究定義都市青年次文化的獨特規範與價值觀。)
Stratigraphic survey geologists work systematically to subdivide dense shale rock units into precisely localized mineral zones. (地層調查地質學家系統化地工作，以將緻密的頁岩岩石單元細分為（把…再分）精確局部的礦物帶。)
The police force managed to subdue the rioters after several hours. (警方在幾個小時後成功壓制了暴動者。)
The militaristic centralized state utilized its garrison to subjugate peripheral tribespeople along the frontier. (軍事主義的中央集權國家利用其衛戍部隊，來征服邊疆沿線的外圍部落住民。)
The indigenous populations historical accounts detail their resistance against colonial subjugation. (原住民的歷史記載詳細描述了他們對殖民征服的反抗。)
The wealthy businessman attempted to suborn the key prosecution witness by offering a massive financial bribe. (這位富商企圖透過提供巨額賄款來收買檢方的關鍵證人。)
The volcanic winter blocked sunlight, and global agricultural yields subsequently dropped for consecutive seasons. (火山冬季阻擋了陽光，全球農業產量隨後連續數個季節下降。)
Nomadic pastoralist groups can subsist across hyper-arid steppe zones by consuming milk and products from herded livestock. (游牧牧民群體可以透過消耗放牧牲畜的乳汁與產品，在極度乾旱的大草原地帶維持生存。)

meaning: 維持生存；生存最低限度的生活物資
example: Before specialized labor division expanded, early Neolithic tribes practiced small-scale subsistence home gardening. (在專業勞動分工擴張之前，新石器時代早期的部落從事小規模的維持生存家庭園藝。)
The hypothesis regarding ancient Martian surface water was fully substantiated by the rover's extraction of gypsum layers. (關於古代火星地表水的假設，透過探測車對石膏層的提取得到了完全證實。)
Lichens function as pioneer colonizers by attaching tightly to the bare granite rock substrate following volcanic eruptions. (在地質火山爆發後，地衣藉由緊緊附著在裸露的花崗岩岩石基質（底層）上，充當先驅的拓殖生物。)
Radar anomalies indicated the presence of substantial subsurface ice reserves near the Martian equator. (雷達異常顯示在火星赤道附近存在大量地表下的冰儲量。)
The museum curator added a explanatory text subtitle to the ancient Mesopotamian cuneiform slab display card. (博物館館長在古代美索不達米亞楔形文字厚板的展示卡上，添加了解釋性的文字副標題（字幕）。)
Subtractive sculpture involves carving away material from a marble block until the desired form emerges. (減法雕刻涉及從大理石塊上雕刻掉材料，直到所需的形狀顯現出來。)
The subtropic zone experiences long clement growing seasons, permitting sedentary groups to master intensive legume agriculture. (亞熱帶地帶經歷漫長溫和的生長季節，容許定居群體掌握密集性的豆科植物農業。)
Subtropical biomes experience prolonged clement seasons, supporting the systematic horticulture of citrus crops. (亞熱帶生物群系經歷長期的溫和季節，支持著柑橘作物的系統化園藝耕作。)
The expansion of passenger railway systems expedited suburbanization, shifting demographics away from the metropolis core. (客運鐵路系統的擴張加快了郊區化進程，將人口從大都市核心區轉移出去。)
Ecologists track the successional timeline of pioneer plants that colonize barren rock zones following a volcanic event. (生態學家追蹤在火山事件後，拓殖荒蕪岩石區域的先驅植物的演替（接續）時間線。)
A succulent plant thrives in hyper-arid desert biomes by utilizing specialized tissue to store rainwater resources. (多肉植物藉由利用特化的組織來儲存雨水資源，在極度乾旱的沙漠生物群系中茂盛生長。)
The weakened patient unfortunately began to succumb to the aggressive bacterial infection despite receiving antibiotic treatment. (儘管接受了抗生素治療，身體虛弱的患者遺憾地還是開始屈服於（死於）嚴重的細菌感染。)
The vacuum cleaner relies on strong suction to remove dust from carpets. (吸塵器依賴強大的吸力來清除地毯上的灰塵。)
The local ecosystem changed suddenly when an invasive predatory fish was accidentally introduced into the lake. (當一種具侵略性的捕食性魚類被意外引入湖中時，當地的生態系統突然發生了變化。)
The island community achieved food sufficiency by developing sustainable aquaponics and vertical agriculture. (該島嶼社區透過發展永續的魚菜共生和垂直農業，實現了糧食自給自足。)

meaning: 參政權擴大論者；女權運動者（尤指爭取投票權）
example: The prominent 19th-century suffragist faced legal arrest for attempting to cast a ballot in the presidential election. (這位19世紀著名的女權運動者因企圖在總統大選中投票而面臨法律逮捕。)
The asymmetric geometry engraved onto the archaic earthenware slab is highly suggestive of early maritime calendar maps. (雕刻在古老土器厚板上不對稱的幾何形狀，高度具暗示性（啟發性），讓人聯想到早期的航海曆法地圖。)
The monumental architecture of the citadel council chambers was explicitly designed to befit a suitably elite aristocrat. (城堡議會大廳宏偉不朽的建築被明確設計，以與一位適當高階的精英貴族身份相稱。)
Volcanic eruptions inject sulfate particles into the atmosphere, reflecting solar rays and inducing cooling. (火山爆發將硫酸鹽顆粒注入大氣中，反射太陽光線並引發降溫效應。)
The corporate financial scandal threatened to permanently sully the pristine reputation of the banking giant. (這起公司財務醜聞威脅到要永久玷污這家銀行巨頭純潔無瑕的聲譽。)
Natural language processing models are thoroughly evaluated on their ability to perform accurate text summarization. (自然語言處理模型在進行精確文本摘要的能力上，受到了徹底的評估。)
During the height of summertime, regional power grids experience peak demand due to ubiquitous air conditioning use. (在夏季最盛之時，由於空調的普遍使用，地方電網會經歷用電高峰的需求。)
Elite aristocratic chambers inside the ancient metropolis were embellished with sumptuous woven tapestries and glazed pots. (古代大都市內部的精英貴族大廳，裝飾有華麗的（奢侈的）編織織錦壁毯與塗釉罐子。)
The archeologists carefully excavated the sunbaked clay tablets containing ancient cuneiform script. (考古學家仔細挖掘了含有古代楔形文字、經烈日曝曬的泥板。)

meaning: 陽光穿透雲霧、旭日形裝飾
example: The antique mirror featured a dramatic golden sunburst frame that became the focal point of the exhibition room. (這面古董鏡子配有一個引人注目的金色旭日形裝飾鏡框，成為展覽室的焦點。)
Marine alga bladders float close to the sunlit ocean surface to maximize carbon dioxide absorption during photosynthesis. (海洋藻類的氣囊漂浮在靠近陽光照射的海洋表面附近，以在光合作用期間最大化二氧化碳的吸收。)
The graphic designer decided to superimpose the text onto the background image. (平面設計師決定將文字疊加到背景圖片上。)
Many indigenous myths attribute unpredictable weather events to the whims of powerful supernatural entities. (許多原住民神話將不可預測的天氣事件歸因於強大超自然實體的反覆無常。)
The invention of printing presses did not instantly supersede manual manuscripts, but it modernized text networks fundamentally. (印刷機的發明並未立即取代手工手稿，但它從根本上使文字網絡現代化。)
The archaic text fragment was supposedly inscribed by an early Babylonian mathematician, though verification remains incomplete. (該古老文字碎片據推測是由一位早期巴比倫數學家所雕刻的，儘管查證工作尚未完成。)

meaning: 至高無上；優勢；主導地位
example: The military supremacy of the coastal citadel empire depended entirely on advanced outrigger watercraft fabrication. (沿海城堡帝國的軍事主導地位（優勢），完全取決於先進的支撐浮筒船隻的製造。)
A service surcharge will be added to all bills during the public holiday. (國定假日期間所有帳單都將加收服務附加費。)
With determination and meticulous planning, the elite climbing team managed to surmount the treacherous peak. (憑藉著決心與縝密的計畫，這支菁英登山隊成功克服了重重困難，登上了這座險峻的山峰。)
A government surveyor mapped the western frontier to prepare the territory for agricultural settlement. (政府測量員對西部邊疆進行了地圖繪製，以便為該領地的農業定居做準備。)
The industrialization of textile outwork led to mass-produced cotton suspender straps, replacing traditional rawhide components. (紡織家庭代工的工業化帶來了大量生產的棉質吊帶，取代了傳統的生牛皮部件。)
Nomadic pastoralists drive herds across extensive steppe landscapes to secure seasonal milk and meat products for tribal sustenance. (游牧民驅趕牲畜跨越廣闊的大草原景觀，以獲取季節性的乳汁與肉製品來維持部落生存（營養）。)
The engineering crew faced severe logistical obstacles when building a roadway across the swampy terrain. (工程人員在穿越沼澤地形建造道路時，面臨了嚴重的物流後勤障礙。)
The strenuous physical labor in the high-temperature factory left the workers completely sweaty by mid-day. (在高溫工廠裡費力的體力勞動，讓工人們在中午時分完全出汗。)

meaning: 徹底的；廣泛的；漫天席卷的
example: The newly elected Prime Minister promised to introduce sweeping economic reforms to reduce national debt. (新當選的總理承諾引入徹底的經濟改革以減少國家債務。)
The ancient ichthyosaur was an exceptionally dynamic marine swimmer, utilizing a fishlike tail for propulsion. (古代魚龍是一種格外強勁的海洋游泳生物，利用類似魚類的尾巴進行推進。)
The white-collar criminal orchestrated a complex Ponzi scheme to swindle elderly investors out of their retirement savings. (這名白領罪犯精心策劃了一個複雜的龐氏騙局，以騙取老年投資人的退休儲蓄。)
Intense atmospheric storms on Jupiter cause gaseous chemical layers to swirl into massive, dynamic eddies. (木星上強烈的大氣暴風雨，導致氣態的化學層旋轉成巨大的動態渦流。)
The fans would swoon whenever the pop star smiled at them. (每當流行歌星對粉絲微笑時，他們都會為之迷醉。)
The eagle began to swoop down from the sky to catch its prey. (老鷹開始從空中俯衝而下以捕捉獵物。)
Mycorrhizal fungi establish a symbiotic relationship with plant roots, exchanging nutrients for carbohydrates. (菌根真菌與植物根部建立共生關係，以營養成分交換碳水化合物。)
The precise synchronization of avian hatching schedules ensures that all nestlings emerge when insect food is peak. (鳥類孵化時間表的精確同步化，確保了所有雛鳥都在昆蟲食物達到高峰時破殼而出。)
Many marine invertebrates synchronize their spawning schedules with lunar cycles to maximize external fertilization rates. (許多海洋無脊椎動物使其產卵時間表與月球週期同步，以最大化體外受精率。)
The manufacturing machinery utilizes a digital synchronizer to ensure that all assembly robotic arms move in exact unison. (這台製造機械利用數位同步裝置，以確保所有組裝機器手臂完全同步移動。)
Plants utilize specific specialized organelles to synthesize essential complex starches from simple glucose molecules. (植物利用特定的特化細胞器，從簡單的葡萄糖分子中合成出必要的複雜澱粉。)
The museum features tactile exhibits designed for visually impaired visitors. (該博物館設有專為視障遊客設計的觸覺展品。)
During the academic lecture, the professor suddenly went off on a fascinating tangent about medieval history. (在學術講座中，教授突然扯開話題，聊起了關於中世紀歷史的迷人題外話。)
The bakery window displayed a tantalizing array of fresh pastries. (麵包店的櫥窗裡展示了一系列誘人的新鮮糕點。)

meaning: 織錦；壁毯；豐富多樣的畫面
example: The cultural anthropologist described the egalitarian society as a complex social tapestry of mutualistic kinship links. (文化人類學家將這個平等主義社會，描述為一個由互利共生親屬關係連結組成的複雜社會織錦畫面。)
The corporate employee handbook explicitly states that chronic tardiness is grounds for immediate termination. (公司員工手冊明確規定，長期遲到是立即解雇的理由。)
The scandal managed to tarnish the reputation of the famous politician. (這場醜聞玷污了這位著名政治家的聲譽。)
Preindustrial artisans handcrafted reliable hunting bows by stretching raw hide strips taut across flexible yew branches. (工業化前的工匠藉由將生牛皮條繃緊拉落在具彈性的紫杉樹枝上，手工製作出可靠的狩獵弓。)
The friendly tavernkeeper welcomed the weary travelers and provided them with warm food and shelter. (這位友善的酒館老闆迎接了疲憊的旅人，並為他們提供熱食與住所。)
The centralized state collected heavy agricultural taxes from sedentary farmers to fund monumental architectural projects. (中央集權國家向定居的農民徵收沉重的農業稅，以資助宏偉的建築計畫。)

The ancestral pueblo dwellers were technologically sophisticated, building multistory stone dwellings inside defensive alcoves. (祖傳普埃布洛居民在技術上非常先進，在具防禦性的凹處內部建造了多層石造住宅。)

meaning: 構造地質學；板塊構造論

The mechanization of piecework operations inside automated textile mills reduced workers to mechanical tedium. (自動化紡織廠內計件工作作業的機械化，將工人降低到了機械式的單調乏味狀態中。)
Equatorial rainforest canopies teem with an unmatched multiplicity of highly specialized biological invertebrate groups. (赤道的雨林樹冠內部，充滿了（湧現）無與論比且高度特化的生物無脊椎動物群落多樣性。)

meaning: 遠距通勤者、在家工作者
example: The expansion of broadband internet allowed the modern telecommuter to work efficiently from remote regions. (寬頻網路的普及讓現代的遠距通勤者能夠在偏遠地區高效地工作。)
The advent of high-speed digital networks enabled telecommuting, altering traditional urban commuting patterns. (高速數位網路的出現實現了遠距辦公，改變了傳統的都市通勤型態。)

Before oil mediums expanded, medieval craftspeople combined natural mineral pigments with organic eggshell binders to manufacture tempera paint. (在油性媒介擴張之前，中世紀的手手工藝人將天然礦物顏料與有機蛋殼黏合劑結合，以製造出蛋彩顏料。)
Temperate forests experience four distinct seasons, with moderate temperatures and reliable precipitation. (溫帶森林經歷四季分明的氣候，氣溫適中且降雨穩定。)
Radiocarbon tracking allows paleontologists to establish precise temporal benchmarks for ancient faunal extinctions. (放射性碳追蹤容許古生物學家為古代動物群滅絕，建立精確的時間時間基準。)

meaning: （尤指都市貧民區的）廉租公寓
example: Rapid industrialization provoked urban overcrowding, forcing immigrant laborers to crowd into hazardous tenement quarters. (快速工業化引發城市過度擁擠，迫使移民勞工擠進危險的廉租公寓宿舍區。)
The output efficiency of commercial cotton cleaning multiplied tenfold following the introduction of the Whitney mechanical gin. (在引入惠特尼機械軋棉機之後，商業棉花清理的輸出效率乘倍增加了十倍。)
An invertebrate like the jellyfish uses each venomous tentacle to paralyze and capture swimming fish. (像水母這樣的無脊椎動物利用其每條有毒的觸手來麻痺並捕捉游泳的魚類。)
The grand central railway station serves as the northern terminus for the country's high-speed rail network. (大中央火車站是該國高速鐵路網絡的北方終點站。)

meaning: 恐怖地、令人心驚膽戰地
example: The systemic volcanic eruption progressed terrifyingly fast, forcing immediate evacuation of the island. (系統性火山爆發進行得恐怖地快速，迫使該島嶼立即進行疏散。)
The heterogeneous textural profile of glacial moraine rocks mixes coarse boulder layers with exceptionally fine sand granules. (冰磧石高度異質的紋理（質地）特徵，將粗糙的巨石層與異常細緻的砂粒混合在一起。)
During the brief spring thaw, the top layers of tundra permafrost melt, turning landscapes into swampy wetlands. (在短暫的春季融化期間，凍原永凍土的頂層融化，將地貌轉變為沼澤濕地。)
The politician gestured theatrically during the debate to emphasize his points to the television audience. (這位政治人物在辯論中做出了戲劇化的手勢，向電視觀眾強調他的觀點。)
An evolutionary theorist posits that behavior, much like physical anatomy, is shaped by natural selection. (一位演化理論家假定，行為就如同身體結構一樣，是受到天擇塑造的。)
Geologists theorize that Earth's internal core remains solid despite high temperatures due to intense pressure. (地質學家推論，儘管溫度很高，但由於強烈的壓力，地球的內部核心仍然保持固體狀態。)
The second law of thermodynamic principles dictates that the total entropy of an isolated system always increases. (熱力學第二定律規定，孤立系統的總熵總是增加的。)

meaning: 獸腳亞目恐龍 (如暴龍、肉食恐龍)
example: Avian evolutionary theorists argue that modern birds descended directly from a specialized lineage of Mesozoic theropod dinosaurs. (鳥類演化理論家認為，現代鳥類直接起源於中生代獸腳亞目恐龍的一個特化血統。)
The Renaissance humanist thinker rejected rigid medieval pedagogy, prioritizing naturalism and individualistic arts. (文藝復興時期的人文主義思想家拒絕僵硬的中世紀教學法，優先考慮自然主義與個人主義藝術。)
Subsurface calcareous ooze layers are distributed thinly across high-velocity ocean floor rift boundaries. (地表下鈣質軟泥層，薄薄地分佈在高速的海床裂谷邊界跨度間。)
Before mechanization, agriculturalists had to manually thresh harvested grain to separate the seed from the fibrous husk. (在機械化之前，農業勞動者必須手動打穀收割的穀物，以將種子與纖維外殼分離。)
The dynamic tidal currents inside the estuary deposit fine layers of mineral-rich silt twice a day. (河口內動態的潮汐洋流每天兩次沉積下細緻的富含礦物質淤泥層。)
Above the alpine timberline, harsh environmental conditions prevent the growth of tall trees. (在高山林木線以上，惡劣的環境條件阻礙了高大樹木的生長。)
Geological transformations operate on a massive timescale that is measured in millions rather than hundreds of years. (地質轉變在宏大的時間尺度上運作，是以數百萬年而非數百年來計算的。)
Archaeologists excavated an ancient agricultural tool featuring bone tines designed for sorting harvested acorns. (考古學家挖掘出了一種古代農業工具，其特徵是具有專為分選採集橡實而設計的骨製尖齒。)

After hibernating throughout the freezing winter months, the bear gradually emerged from its energetic torpor. (在度過整個寒冷冬月的冬眠後，熊逐漸從其精力的遲鈍麻木狀態中甦醒過來。)
Early mechanical engineers designed expanding steam engines to maximize the rotational torque driven into metal pistons. (早期的機械工程師設計了膨脹式蒸汽機，以最大化驅動進入金屬活塞的旋轉扭矩。)

meaning: 一列車的載貨量/乘客量

meaning: 恍惚；出神狀態；催眠狀態

Watercolor artists layers translucent washes of pigment to preserve the underlying bright reflectivity of the paper. (水彩藝術家堆疊半透明的顏料層，以保持紙張底層明亮的反射率。)

The citizens eventually revolted against the tyrannical ruler who had oppressed them for decades. (公民們最終起義反抗了壓迫他們數十年的暴虐統治者。)

meaning: 無所不在的；普遍存在的

meaning: 神秘的；離奇的；不可思議的

meaning: 地圖上未標明的；未知的

meaning: 不加批判的；缺乏審辨力的

meaning: 非勞動所得的；不當得利的

The continuous, unending accumulation of calcareous ooze on the deep seabed shapes thick limestone layers over eras. (深海床上鈣質軟泥持續、無止境的累積，跨越時代塑造出了厚實的石灰岩層。)

meaning: 未合併的；未成立公司的

The magician waved his wooden wand and a white rabbit suddenly appeared. (魔術師揮了揮木製魔杖，一隻白兔突然出現了。)
The lonely wanderer traveled through various continents, documenting different cultural traditions in his journal. (這位孤獨的漫遊者遊歷了各個大陸，在日記中記錄了不同的文化傳統。)

meaning: 想要（want to 的口語縮寫）
example: In casual conversations, native English speakers often contract words, saying 'wanna' instead of 'want to'. (在日常對話中，英語母語人士經常縮寫單字，說「wanna」而不是「wantto」。)
As global temperatures increase, warmer ocean waters can trigger severe bleaching in coral reefs. (隨著全球氣溫上升，更溫暖的海水可能會引發珊瑚礁的嚴重白化。)
Persistent exposure to moisture-laden air can warp structural cedar timberline beams, destabilizing the roof. (持續暴露於富含水分的空氣中會使結構性的雪松原木樑變形，導致屋頂不穩定。)

meaning: 兔子窩；擁擠嘈雜的地方
example: The underground warren built by rabbits consists of an intricate network of interconnected tunnels. (由兔子建造的地下兔窩，包含了一個由相互連接的隧道所組成的複雜網絡。)
A wasp built a nest under the eaves of the old house. (一隻黃蜂在老房子的屋簷下築了巢。)
Early manufacturing techniques were highly wasteful, discarding substantial metal remnants during tool extraction. (早期的製造技術非常浪費，在工具提取開採過程中丟棄了大量的金屬殘留物。)
The traditional elder criticized the inefficient use of resource allocations, calling the redundant projects a waster of funds. (傳統長老批評了資源分配的效率低下，稱這些冗餘的專案為資金的浪費。)
The seasoned bird watcher documented a rare migratory species passing through the wetland reserve. (這位經驗豐富的鳥類觀察者記錄下了一種穿過濕地保護區的稀有候選遷徙物種。)
Nineteenth-century landscape artists utilized watercolor to capture the translucent, fleeting qualities of light. (十九世紀的風景藝術家利用水彩來捕捉光線半透明且稍縱即逝quantitative的特質。)
The heavy rain caused the small watercourse to overflow its banks. (大雨導致這條小水道溢出了河岸。)
The geometric mapping coordinates delineated how post-glacial seasonal meltwater stream channels formed dynamic regional watercourses. (幾何地圖繪製座標描繪了冰河期後季節性融水溪流通道，如何形成動態的區域水道。)
The invention of reliable outrigger watercraft permitted early Polynesians to execute expansive oversea migrations. (可靠的支撐浮筒船隻的發明，容許早期的玻里尼西亞人執行擴張性的海外遷徙。)
The commercial mercantile metropolis expanded its stone wharf infrastructure along the navigable river waterfront sector. (這座商業重商主義大都市，沿著可通航的河流濱水區部門擴張了其石造碼頭基礎設施。)
Early nineteenth-century textile factories were located near fast-flowing rivers to directly exploit mechanical waterpower. (十九世紀早期的紡織工廠位於流速快的河流附近，以直接利用機械水力。)
The confirmation of lithospheric drift mapping tools marked a critical historical watershed inside modern geological paradigms. (地殼板塊漂移地圖繪製工具的證實，標記了現代地質學範式內部一個關鍵的歷史轉折點（分水嶺）。)
The city's newly developed waterside district has become a major hub for cultural events and fine dining. (這座城市新開發的河岸區已成為文化活動與精緻美食的主要中心。)
Photosynthetic pigments absorb specific wavelengths of light while reflecting others, giving leaves their color. (光合色素吸收特定波長的光，同時反射其他波長，從而賦予葉片顏色。)
As the moon waxes toward its full phase, certain nocturnal marine organisms display altered behavioral patterns. (隨著月亮漸滿趨向滿月相位，某些夜行性海洋生物會表現出改變的行為模式。)
Rocks undergo weathering over thousands of years due to wind and rain. (由於風吹雨打，岩石在數千年間經歷了風化作用。)
An expert outwork weaver could turn raw flax strands into exceptionally uniform linen textiles on a handcraft loom. (一位專家級的家庭代工編織工，能在手工藝織布機上將亞麻纖維原料變成異常均勻的亞麻織品。)
Cuneiform is an ancient system of writing characterized by wedge-shaped marks. (楔形文字是一種古代書寫系統，其特點是楔形符號。)
The abandoned agricultural field rapidly turned into a weedy patch dominated by invasive botanical species. (被廢棄的農田迅速變成了一個由入侵植物物種主導、長滿雜草的區塊。)
The government minister spoke weightily about the long-term fiscal consequences of the mounting national debt. (政府部長沉重地談到了日益增加的國債所帶來的長期財政後果。)
The upscale commercial district targets well-heeled consumers looking for rare luxury fashion merchandise. (這個高檔商業區鎖定的是尋找稀有奢華時尚商品的富裕消費者。)
The westward expansion of settlers in nineteenth-century America forced indigenous tribes from their lands. (十九世紀美國定居者向西擴張，迫使原住民部落離開他們的土地。)
A wetland ecosystem functions as a natural filtration barrier, removing harmful synthetic runoff from waterways. (濕地生態系統扮演著天然過濾屏障的角色，能從水路中清除有害的人工逕流。)
The Whig party in nineteenth-century America generally supported industrial development and a stronger federal government. (十九世紀美國的輝格黨大致上支持工業發展與更強大的聯邦政府。)
On a sudden whim, the couple decided to purchase plane tickets and fly to Italy for the weekend. (一時興起之下，這對夫婦決定購買機票，週末飛往義大利度假。)
Paleolithic toolmakers would meticulously whittle straight cedar branches to manufacture rudimentary hunting arrows. (舊石器時代的工具製造者會細心地修削筆直的雪松樹枝，以製造基本的狩獵箭矢。)
The evolutionary transition toward powered flight in pterosaurs was wholly independent of the later development in birds. (翼龍向動力飛行的演化轉變，完全獨立於後來鳥類的發展。)
The specialized cotton wick was engineered to burn evenly without creating excessive carbon smoke. (這種專用的棉製蠟燭芯經過精心設計，能均勻燃燒而不會產生過多的碳煙。)
The patio was decorated with elegant wicker furniture that had been treated to withstand seasonal weather conditions. (露台擺設了優雅的柳條編織家具，這些家具經過處理以耐受季節性的天氣條件。)
The dictator continues to wield absolute power over the country's media. (獨裁者繼續對國家的媒體行使絕對的權力。)

meaning: 投機鑽探油井者、冒險投機者
example: The daring wildcatter risked his entire life savings drilling for oil in an unexplored region of Texas. (這位大膽的投機鑽探油井者冒著失去全部積蓄的風險，在德州一個未開發的地區鑽探石油。)
The ecological restoration project successfully reestablished native wildflower populations in the meadow. (該生態復育專案成功地在草地上重建了原生野花群落。)
The judge determined that the corporation's failure to report the chemical leak constituted a willful violation of toxic laws. (法官認定，該公司未通報化學洩漏的行為構成了對有毒物質法律的故意違反。)
The volunteers willingly dedicated their weekend to clearing plastic debris from the local marine sanctuary. (志工們自願地將週末時間奉獻給清理當地海洋保護區的塑膠垃圾。)
The early mechanical windmill allowed agrarian societies to pump subsurface water to irrigate arid fields. (早期的機械風車允許農業社會抽取地下水來灌溉乾旱的田地。)
Entomologists identified a rare species of wingless insects that thrived exclusively in the isolated cave network. (昆蟲學家鑑定出一種完全在孤立洞穴網絡中繁衍的稀有外來無翅昆蟲物種。)
The climbers faced fierce, wintry conditions as they neared the frozen summit of the mountain. (登山客在接近結冰的山頂時，面臨著兇猛、寒冷的冬季氣候。)
Historically, the development of the wirephoto allowed newspaper agencies to transmit visual imagery across long distances. (在歷史上，傳真照片的發展讓報社能夠跨越遙遠的距離傳輸視覺影像。)

meaning: 纖細的；微弱的；一縷縷的
example: The comet's luminous coma contains wispy tails of volatile gas molecules vaporized by intense solar radiation. (彗星發光的彗髮中，包含由強烈太陽輻射蒸發的揮發性氣體分子所組成的纖細尾巴。)
The sheep grazed peacefully across the vast, rolling wold of northern England during the summer months. (在夏季的幾個月裡，綿羊在英格蘭北部廣闊、起伏的荒原上悠閒地吃草。)
The anthropological study documented the traditional rituals that celebrate the transition into womanhood. (這項人類學研究記錄了慶祝過渡到成年女性時期的傳統儀式。)
A traditional woodcut illustration requires carving away negative space, leaving raised lines to hold the ink. (傳統的木刻版畫插圖需要雕刻掉空白處，留下凸起的線條來容納墨水。)
The ancient art of woodcutting allowed for the mass production of illustrations before modern printing techniques emerged. (在現代印刷技術出現之前，古老的木刻術使得插圖的大量生產成為可能。)
An expert woodworker crafted durable dugout canoes by meticulously hollowing out straight cedar tree trunks. (一位專家級的木工藉由細心地挖空筆直的雪松樹幹，製造出了耐用的挖空獨木舟。)
Angiosperm shrubs are classified as woody plants due to the persistent accumulation of rigid lignin inside their stems. (被子植物灌木因其莖內硬質木質素的持續累積，而被歸類為木本植物。)
The expansion of the mercantile textile guild fueled a massive demand for raw woolen materials from pastoralists. (商業紡織公會的擴張，刺激了對牧民提供羊毛原料的大量需求。)
The engineering team developed a highly workable solution that addressed the software glitch without requiring a total reboot. (工程團隊開發出了一個非常可行的解決方案，在不需要完全重開機的情況下解決了軟體故障。)
Before standard labor laws formalize the five-day workweek, an industrial laborer endured a twelve-hour workday. (在標準勞工法將五天工作週正式化之前，一名工業勞工要忍受長達十二小時的工作日。)
Ecologists utilize a standardized worksheet to systematically catalog plant density inside an experimental plot. (生態學家利用標準化工作表，來系統化地登記實驗樣區內的植物密度。)
The institutionalization of the standardized five-day workweek provided laborers with more structured leisure time. (標準化五天工作週的制度化，為勞工提供了更具結構性的休閒時間。)
An ancient Mayan worshipper would present luxury earthenware pottery artifacts at centralized cavern temples to gratify local deities. (古代馬雅崇拜者會在集中的溶洞神廟內奉獻奢侈的土器陶器工藝品，以滿足當地的神明。)
The academic committee thoroughly evaluated the scientific worthiness of the proposal before allocating the research grant. (學術委員會在撥發研究資助之前，徹底評估了該提案的科學價值。)
The biodegradable plastic wrapper was engineered to decompose naturally within six months of disposal. (這種可生物降解的塑膠包裝紙經過工程設計，能在丟棄後六個月內自然分解。)

meaning: 不幸的人；可憐的人；惡棍
example: The historical novel depicted the miserable life of a homeless wretch struggling to survive during the industrial revolution. (這部歷史小說描繪了一個在工業革命期間努力生存、無家可歸的可憐人所度過的悲慘生活。)
The patient began to writhe in agony as the severe stomach cramps intensified before the medication took effect. (在藥物發效之前，隨著嚴重的胃絞痛加劇，病人開始痛苦地扭曲掙扎。)
Xenon is an exceptionally heavy noble gas found in minuscule trace amounts within Earth's modern atmosphere. (氙氣是一種在地球現代大氣中以微小痕量形式存在的、異常沉重的惰性氣體。)
Species richness surveys function as a standard biological yardstick for measuring the resilience of a forest ecosystem. (物種豐富度調查，充當衡量森林生態系統恢復力（韌性）的標準生物衡量標準。)
The ewes are expected to yean during the early days of spring as the weather turns warmer. (隨著天氣轉暖，母羊預計將在早春時節產仔。)
The Yellowstone volcanic caldera sits over a dynamic hotspot, generating extensive geothermal electricity potential deep within the mantle. (黃石火山破火山口坐落在一個動態熱點上，在地函深處內部產生了廣泛的地熱能發電潛力。)
The dog gave a sudden yelp when its tail was accidentally stepped on by the pedestrian. (當狗的尾巴不小心被路人踩到時，牠突然發出了一聲尖叫。)
The tough, flexible wood of the old yew tree was highly prized by prehistoric toolmakers for carving weapons. (古老紫杉樹堅韌、具彈性的木材，被史前工具製造者高度珍視以用於雕刻武器。)
He approached his new scientific research project with absolute zest. (他以絕對的熱情投入到他的新科學研究計畫中。)

meaning: 古代蘇美人的神廟、梯形金字塔
example: Archeologists excavated the ruins of an ancient Mesopotamian ziggurat dedicated to the lunar deity. (考古學家挖掘了一座供奉月亮神祇的古代美索不達米亞梯形金字塔遺跡。)
The pottery shards were embellished with a sharp zigzag pattern incised with a bone tool. (陶器碎片上裝飾著用骨製工具刻劃的尖銳鋸齒形圖案。)
Zirconium is widely utilized in the nuclear energy sector due to its exceptional resistance to corrosion. (鋯因其卓越的耐腐蝕性，被廣泛應用於核能領域。)
A marine zoologist tracks the vocalization behaviors of whales to chart group migration routes. (海洋動物學家追蹤鯨魚的發聲行為，以繪製群體遷徙路線圖。)
The university's department of zoology launched a long-term field study on the migration patterns of apex predators. (該大學的動物學系對頂級捕食者的遷移模式，展開了一項長期的野外研究。)
The scientist became internationally recognized after discovering a new chemical element. (這位科學家在發現一種新的化學元素後，在國際間獲得了認可。)

meaning: 佩拉（古馬其頓首都或地名）
example: Pella is historical as the ancient capital of Macedonia and the birthplace of Alexander the Great. (佩拉在歷史上相當著名，它是古馬其頓的首都，也是亞歷山大大帝的誕生地。)
The skilled goldsmith meticulously designed an intricate crown for the royal coronation. (這位技藝精湛的金匠為皇室加冕典禮精心設計了一頂錯綜複雜的皇冠。)
Traditional Japanese ukiyo-e prints were created using a sophisticated woodblock printing technique. (傳統的日本浮世繪版畫是利用一種精細的木刻版印刷技術創作出來的。)
Sailing upwind requires sailors to constantly adjust the sails at a precise angle to the wind. (逆風航行要求水手們不斷地將帆調整到與風向呈精確角度的位置。)
In medieval warfare, infantry units deployed long pikes to defend against oncoming cavalry charges. (在中世紀的戰爭中，步兵部隊會部署長矛以防禦迎面而來的騎兵衝鋒。)

meaning: 車轍；刻板乏味的生活常軌
example: The company's creative team realized they were in a mental rut and needed innovative ideas. (該公司的創意團隊意識到他們陷入了思維的刻板常軌中，需要創新的想法。)
The ancient Silk Road was a historical overland trade route connecting Asia with Europe. (古代絲綢之路是一條連接亞洲與歐洲的歷史性陸路貿易路線。)
The laboratory animal facility maintained strict hygiene standards to prevent any bacterial sty. (該實驗室的動物設施保持了嚴格的衛生標準，以防止任何細菌性的針眼發生。)
The political election remained close because a massive portion of voters was still undecided. (這場政治選舉依舊僵持不下，因為很大一部分的選民仍然猶豫不決。)
Placental mammals give birth to relatively mature offspring compared to marsupial species. (與有袋類動物相比，胎盤哺乳動物產下的後代發育相對成熟。)
The spiny anteater, or echidna, uses its sharp needles as a primary defense mechanism. (多刺的食蟻獸（又稱針鼴）利用其鋒利的針刺作為主要的防禦機制。)
The corporation's continuous insensitivity to local environmental concerns sparked major public protests. (該公司對當地環境問題持續的漠不關心，引發了大規模的公眾抗議。)
The contemporary printmaker experimented with various chemical etching styles on metal plates. (這位當代版畫家在金屬板上嘗試了各種化學蝕刻風格。)
Serigraphy allows artists to apply vibrant, layered ink colors onto diverse textile materials. (絲網印刷（絹印）使藝術家能夠在各式各樣的紡織材料上印上鮮豔、具層次感的油墨顏色。)
Geneticists study the specific dominant alleles responsible for producing curly hair in human populations. (遺傳學家研究負責在人類族群中產生捲曲頭髮的特定顯性等位基因。)
The municipal waterworks underwent a massive technological upgrade to filter out microscopic microplastics. (市自來水廠進行了大規模的技術升級，以過濾掉微小的塑膠微粒。)

meaning: 替代（常用於 in lieu of）
example: The university offered students online academic courses in lieu of traditional in-person lectures during winter. (冬季期間，該大學提供線上學術課程來替代傳統的面授講座。)
The scenic parkway offers travelers breathtaking panoramic views of the rolling Appalachian mountains. (這條景觀大道為旅人提供了起伏的阿帕拉契山脈之絕美全景。)
The university constructed a multipurpose auditorium designed for theatrical plays, sports, and exams. (該大學建造了一個多功能禮堂，設計用於戲劇演出、體育活動和考試。)
A calm green environment can create a highly restful atmosphere conducive to psychological recovery. (寧靜的綠色環境可以營造出非常放鬆的氛圍，有助於心理復原。)
Philosophers debate whether certain abstract structural logical concepts preexist before human language. (哲學家爭論某些抽象的結構邏輯概念是否在人類語言出現之前就已經存在。)
The politician sued the local newspaper for publishing libelous claims regarding his corporate finances. (這位政治人物控告當地報社發表關於他公司財務的誹謗性指控。)
Honeybees utilize unique physical anatomical structures to collect pollen and efficiently pollinate crops. (蜜蜂利用獨特的身體解剖結構來收集花粉並高效地為作物授粉。)
The pharmaceutical technicians used intense ultraviolet radiation to quickly inactivate the active virus. (製藥技術人員利用強烈的紫外線輻射來迅速使活性病毒失去活性。)
Cross-pollination enhances genetic diversity among flowering plant populations in the ecosystem. (異花授粉增強了生態系統中開花植物群體之間的基因多樣性。)
The CEO unwillingly agreed to resign after facing intense legal pressure from the board of directors. (在面臨董事會強大的法律壓力後，執行長不情願地同意辭職。)
Due to rapid automation, the automobile company launched an intensive initiative to retrain assembly workers. (由於快速的自動化，這家汽車公司啟動了一項密集計畫來重新培訓裝配線工人。)
When driven by primitive fear, animals can behave irrationally, sometimes wandering directly into danger. (當受到原始恐懼的驅使時，動物可能會做出不理性的行為，有時會直接走向危險。)
The engineering team tested the electric vehicle prototype's aerodynamic stability on a closed racetrack. (工程團隊在封閉的賽道上測試了電動車原型的空氣動力學穩定性。)
The comedian's routines were deliberately inoffensive, focusing entirely on wholesome family humor. (這位喜劇演員的演出刻意不帶冒犯性，完全聚焦於健康的家庭幽默。)

meaning: 嬰兒潮世代的人；迅速發展的事物
example: Sociologists analyze how the baby boomer generation significantly reshaped economic housing patterns. (社會學家分析了嬰兒潮世代如何顯著地重塑經濟住房模式。)

meaning: 辛西亞（女子名；月亮女神的別稱）
example: In classical literature, authors frequently invoked the name Cynthia as a poetic personification of the moon. (在古典文學中，作者經常援引「辛西亞」這個名字來作為月亮的詩意擬人化。)
The historical biography depicted the author as a lifelong struggler against systemic societal oppression. (這部歷史傳記將作者描繪成一個終生反抗體制化社會壓迫的奮鬥者。)
The primary objective of the chemical treatment is to thoroughly impregnate the wood with water-resistant resin. (該化學處理的主要目標是讓抗水樹脂徹底浸透木材。)
The sociological study followed childless couples who focused their financial resources entirely on global travel. (這項社會學研究追蹤了將財務資源完全投入於全球旅遊的頂客族（無子女夫婦）。)

meaning: 角質層；（指甲根部的）死皮
